name: @babelforce/rtvbp
description: Generated RTVBP protocol surfaces and browser/Node runtimes

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.verify:package: node --input-type=module -e "const sdk = await import('./dist/index.js'); if (!sdk.babelforceV1 || !sdk.classicV1) throw new Error('missing generated package exports')" && npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
